words: Publisher 0.4.0 carries the history-scope pair into each series: history_scope_claim = inferred and history_scope_basis = the fixed text 'first value day vs source floor', taken from the NEWEST gold row's conditional column history_scope_claim only. A null or absent claim, or a claim on older rows only, writes no pair, and any other claim word is refused. validate_against_contract refuses a lone field, another word or a free-text basis. Both publish handlers read the conditional column only from a partition whose own Parquet schema names it, so a legacy partition written before the derivation neither fails nor makes any statement, and a series built from legacy gold carries no pair. Not proven: nothing is built, uploaded or republished; the two source-map entries for the publisher and the handlers are stale after this cell and are re-pinned by a later cell; no producer has written the claim to S3 yet; and reporting-publish/tests/test_handler_unreported.py still pins 0.3.0 outside this grant (BLOCKING row IRPT_DASHBD-D2-W238-S1), so the publisher test directory does not pass as written.
